THIS IS THE SECOND APP, and the root package.json used to say what that would
trigger: '@ab-ovo/web-kit ... is created when the SECOND app arrives.' It has been
created — see web/web-kit/package.json — and src/content.ts's imports were redirected
to it in the same commit, exactly the 'one import to redirect rather than a search'
its own header predicted. See docs/architecture/MCP-SERVER-SKETCH.md §6, updated
alongside this file rather than left describing a trigger that already fired.
Two runtime dependencies now: the MCP SDK, and @ab-ovo/web-kit for the loader, the
schema types and the validator. The gate this server exists to hold is still pure
TypeScript in src/reveal.ts with no imports at all, so the thing most worth testing
needs no install to test (P13: test at the layer with the logic).
